Absolute,
Show me a line in the sand
Though you alone have none to hand.
Speak of your succour, show me your plans
From silent ground to whispering essence, 
From interwoven fabric to standout substance,
Take my hand, I am touring through, off 
To the Reason and Purpose that are your demand.
